reason_for_revision: First-round implementations mostly converged. The candidate had an unresolved physical-preparation access assumption in the service case. Make mechanism comparison concrete and account for real sequence/access/capacity, not just a budget. No new cases or outputs have been seen.
unchanged_release_gate: Useful material improvements over the committed skill in more than one type of task, with no unresolved severe regression. Qualitative development decision, not statistical superiority.
next_cases: Independent author to create two fresh, less prescriptive tasks: open experience build and constrained product/service decision. All three arms retained; no replacement or deletion of first-round results.
